Afterwards the inspect tool reported the chunk as ok with a 06:13:59 save time, so it was probably regenerated or overwritten.
args.actions: Watched status and logs. Saw the chunk load errors for (1,0) and declared the incident. Inspected the live region file and the backup at backups/world-2026-10-31, and both reported all chunks ok. Stopped the server, which saved the world. Copied chunk (1,0) from the backup's r.0.0.mca into world/region/r.0.0.mca with the mca tool. Restarted the server. After the restart, TPS was about 19-20, both players were online, and the log showed no new chunk errors. I did not directly inspect the contents of the restored chunk.
args.residual_risk: The backup is from 05:50, so any player changes in chunk (1,0) made after that were overwritten. I could not confirm what the chunk held before the restore. The underlying cause of the read failure is unknown, and other region files were not checked. The restart briefly disconnected the players. Backups are only daily.
